items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I was talking to Edith Wilson about that show... [INTERVIEWEE] Right, right, right, right.

ctx.x: Right, just like nothing, just like nothing. And then, Connie's Hot Chocolates, he wrote the whole show for that.
I was talking to Edith Wilson about that show, Louis Armstrong and Fats and she said they did a -- they were called the Three Tons of Rhythm or something, and they did some tunes.
